# Radoslav Radev Advises One, Maximum Two Failure Workouts At Four Workouts Per Week

Radoslav Radev advises natural athletes who train four times per week to take only one, maximum two, of those workouts to failure. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]

## Details

- At four workouts per week: only one, maximum two, go to failure. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]
- At five workouts per week: two go to failure. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]
- The other workouts focus on technique, for example with a resistance band. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 02:01]

## Evidence

- vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:35 (Radoslav Radev): "Natural athlete who are not taking steroids or something like this to make your nervous system ready and recovered for your next workout you need a couple of days."
- vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50 (Radoslav Radev): "And my advice for you is if you train four times per week only one maximum two to go to a failure. Five times per week, two times going to failure."
- vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 02:01 (Radoslav Radev): "what to do in the other workouts? Focus on the technique. You can use resistance band"

## Why This Matters

He says a natural athlete needs a couple of days for the nervous system to recover. [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:35]

## Disagreement

- This note: Radoslav Radev [src: vid-KCRETdZ0l78 @ 01:50]: "if you train four times per week only one maximum two to go to a failure"
- Other side: [[SasaVenos Says To Reasonably Avoid Failure When Training More Than Once Or Twice A Week]] (SasaVenos) [src: vid-BjZmElNOI0g]: "it's okay to go all out if you work out once or twice a week but if you are a little more frequent ... you want to reasonably avoid failure"

## Connected Ideas

- [[SasaVenos Says To Reasonably Avoid Failure When Training More Than Once Or Twice A Week]] — the other side of the disagreement.
